ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity dark region across 80% of the surface. High-intensity contiguous mottling is concentrated on the distal tip of the right lobe. Isolated high-intensity clusters are visible near the median notch and as scattered points on both lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with moderate-to-high frequency serrations; notable deep jagged indentations located on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) located in the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the left lobe and lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks across the left fluke lobe; irregular trailing edge profile suggesting previous tissue loss on the medial section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy white mottling localized specifically to the far right distal tip, creating a high-contrast 'shredded' edge effect.
